nodes.label: API
nodes.description: Single server checking its own local counter.

nodes.label: In-Memory Counter
nodes.description: Resets every fixed window (e.g. once per minute). Doesn't share state across servers.

nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.description: Checks the shared limit before routing to a backend server.

nodes.label: Redis Sliding Window
nodes.description: Shared counter across all servers; sliding window avoids the fixed-window boundary burst.

nodes.label: Edge Rate Limiter
nodes.description: Rejects abusive traffic before it reaches backend servers.

nodes.label: Token Bucket (Redis)
nodes.description: Refills at a steady rate; allows short bursts up to the bucket size.

nodes.label: Tiered Limits
nodes.description: Different limits per endpoint — writes stricter than reads.

nodes.label: Backend API
nodes.description: Only sees traffic that passed the limiter.
